Landstar Sys (LSTR) Shareholder Hillsdale Investment Management Has Cut Stake as Market Value Rose; Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management Continues to Hold Position in Apple Com (AAPL) 
April 16, 2018 - By Henry Gaston 
Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management increased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 13.26% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management bought 6,570 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 56,115 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.50 million, up from 49,545 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Livingston Group Asset Management Southport Capital Management who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $892.87 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.71% or $1.24 during the last trading session, reaching $175.97. About 2.81M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Hillsdale Investment Management Inc decreased its stake in Landstar Sys Inc (LSTR) by 97.8% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hillsdale Investment Management Inc sold 4,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.88% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 90 shares of the transportation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9,000, down from 4,090 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hillsdale Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Landstar Sys Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $4.58 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.40% or $1.5 during the last trading session, reaching $108.75. About 35,525 shares traded. Landstar System, Inc. (NASDAQ:LSTR) has risen 29.78% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.23% the S&P500. 
Hillsdale Investment Management Inc, which manages about $1.05B and $619.74 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Insperity Inc Com (NYSE:NSP) by 14,280 shares to 28,560 shares, valued at $1.64 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Hudbay Minerals Inc (NYSE:HBM) by 101,140 shares in the quarter, for a total of 794,940 shares, and has risen its stake in Enbridge Inc (NYSE:ENB). 
Among 19 analysts covering Landstar System ( NASDAQ:LSTR ), 6 have Buy rating, 3 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 32% are positive. On Friday, October 23 the stock rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank with “Hold”. On Monday, January 8 the stock rating was maintained by Stephens with “Buy”. The company was maintained on Thursday, October 26 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. Zacks upgraded the shares of LSTR in report on Thursday, August 20 to “Hold” rating. The stock has “Underweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Monday, February 26. The firm has “Underperform” rating given on Tuesday, January 17 by Raymond James. Credit Suisse maintained the shares of LSTR in report on Wednesday, March 30 with “Neutral” rating. On Wednesday, March 30 the stock rating was downgraded by Macquarie Research to “Underperform”. As per Friday, October 23, the company rating was maintained by Cowen & Co. 
Analysts await Landstar System, Inc. (NASDAQ:LSTR) to report earnings on April, 25. They expect $1.23 EPS, up 59.74% or $0.46 from last year’s $0.77 per share. LSTR’s profit will be $51.74 million for 22.10 P/E if the $1.23 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.08 actual EPS reported by Landstar System, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 13.89% EPS growth.
